1.consolidated_definition: Fatiga; algo como la angina de pecho. Fragancia de pecho y fragancia en las arcas se oyen solamente entre campesinos. “Eso es, doctor; de aquí me pasa esa fragancia con dolor al brazo.” Martínez Roselló, , p. 38.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fatigue; a sensation akin to angina pectoris. The fragrance of the chest and the fragrance in the arca (likely referring to a type of storage container or chest) is only heard among peasants. "That's it, doctor; from here I get that fragrance with arm pain."
